lines.en: I grind across the arena
My feet sink into the stone floor
Each step shakes loose gravel
I advance along the arena edge
Torches sway as I approach
I turn with my heavy plates
I step over cracked steps
My shadow sweeps the stands
I kick the rubble aside
My weight shifts the tiles
I have slept at this altar
I have always held this spot
My ki turns inside me
Once awake, I do not stop
The arena braziers still burn
I open my hands on my knees
These stones know me
I need no more sleep
I wait for you to cross the floor
My breath bends the flames
I listen to water drip from the vault
Even seated, I loom
I touch the edge of the altar
I rest my fists on my knees

lines.zh: 你把我从沉睡里叫醒了
lines.en: You woke me from my sleep
I look up at this intruder
The arena gate opens once
Your ki is far too thin
I know that stance, you die
I rise to my feet slowly
Backing away will not help
I have your ki

lines.zh: 我看你的眼睛在找出口
lines.en: I see your eyes hunting an exit
You interrupted a long sleep
Come stand in the center
Your life stayed at the gate
I let out a low boom
I give half a step ground
A print stays on my plates
That strike landed true
I settle my weight again
I press a hand to the wound
My ki skips one beat
This will not put me back to sleep
I will fight in earnest
The altar fire still burns
I do not eat while sleeping
Food does not wake my hunger
I woke for battle
Take that thing away
I do not live on such things
Only one offering counts here
Blood serves better than food
My hunger is of another kind
Stop swaying in front of me
You struck my leg
I stand like a stone pillar
You are the one sent back
My shell answers with an echo

lines.zh: 你连我的重量都推不动
lines.en: You cannot move my weight
I press one step forward
My knee takes your charge
The floor tiles jump once
That impact is nothing
Ten more tries change nothing
I keep this arena
I have no companion here
Challengers come, one by one
My duty has no use for that
I remember only fighting
Such questions are far away
My silence is the answer
When the arena empties, I sleep

lines.zh: 这竞技场只留一个人站着。
lines.en: Only one of us leaves this arena standing.
Do not waste time on it
I pick up a chunk of stone
I grind it into powder
This was in my way
I toss it into the stands
I pick up a broken blade
Useless, but I keep it
I lay it on the altar
I look at it a while
Holding it, I recall old fights
These things remain
You have come before me
I accept this challenge
My ki rises in full
This battle has begun

lines.zh: 你站的那个位置太近了
lines.en: You stand far too near
My life bar has lit
I have raised both arms
You broke my sleep
You will pay for that step
This is the fight I waited for
I count you within three steps
The altar fire burns for me
You will not leave this hall
I open my eyes wide to see you
Then let it begin now
This strike is for my long sleep
You are noted in the record
You are at the stands now
I come on, step by step
I read your dodge
The afterimage fools you once
I seal your left route
Your ki is skipping about
I raise my hand and adjust the angle
Stop, and I arrive
This hall has no dead corner
I drive you toward the altar
I wait for your strength to run out
You are counting the distance to the gate
The tiles sink under my feet
I stay within three steps
Do not try to get behind
My ki bends the flames aside
You can hear my breathing
I tighten the ring slowly
I have patience for this fight
You have nowhere left
My hand weighs on your shoulder
One punch shatters the steps
I swat you to the floor
My elbow breaks your guard
My leg sweeps the whole hall
A blast leaves my palm
An afterimage circles behind you
I press you into the tiles
I stir the altar flames up
That one left you in the wall
All my weight comes down
You slide across the floor
Your weapon leaves your hand
The impact rains dust from the vault
A sound comes from deep in the altar
The sleeping boss opens its eyes

lines.zh: 我身上的尘土簌簌落下
lines.en: Dust cascades off my body

lines.zh: 你踏进来的脚步把我叫醒
lines.en: Your footstep woke me
My health bar unfurls overhead

lines.zh: 我从祭坛的座位上起身
lines.en: I rise from the altar seat
Fire lights in all four corners

lines.zh: 我的编号在这场里回响
lines.en: My number echoes in the hall
The chains in the vault begin to swing
The tiles sink as I take a step
This meeting was arranged
I have slept long enough
You hear a second heartbeat
The whole arena wakes
The vault darkens as I stand
The gate closes behind you

lines.zh: 我的影子先落在你身上
lines.en: My shadow lands on you first
I open this fight
Smoke rolls up from the altar
It has been long since I felt this

lines.zh: 火焰绕着我的甲往上舔
lines.en: Flames lick up around my plates

lines.zh: 落地时我砸塌一片地砖
lines.en: I land and collapse the tiles

lines.zh: 水压着我的胸口，气提不起来
lines.en: Water presses my chest and my ki stalls

lines.zh: 爆炸的冲击撞得我偏头
lines.en: The blast knocks my head aside
Arrows bounce off my chest

lines.zh: 咒光穿过甲缝钻进体内
lines.en: Magic slips through my seams

lines.zh: 我沉睡时没吃过，倒也不怕
lines.en: I never ate asleep, and it does not matter
Lightning crawls across my shoulders

lines.zh: 我坠落时祭坛也跟着塌
lines.en: The altar falls as I fall
